content.text: Check covers 2025 files including the new one; passes.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `e5468cd 2025-12: add rows`.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh`. It passed, and it did check the new file: it looks at every `data/2025-*.csv` file and checks that each row has as many fields as the header. The new file has the same header as November's.

The check script prints a note that the nightly import only reloads the month the commit message starts with. That's why the message starts with "2025-12". The original stays in `inbox/` because you only asked me to add it to `data/`.
